answer_1.quote: We then evaluate models with open-ended question answering (QA) under controlled translated and native settings...
answer_1.outputs: The models generate responses to instructions in multiple languages, which are evaluated on various benchmarks including open-ended QA, question answering, and classification tasks.

answer_2.quote: We run 1-shot prompting and measure models' F1 scores... use accuracy as the metric... a strict string-level exact match (EM) and a lenient "include" checking whether the reference is a substring of the model generation... measure exact token match.

answer_3.quote: To avoid expensive human evaluation at scale, we use LLM-as-a-judge, which has shown a strong correlation with human judgement... We use two LLM judges other than the translators to avoid LLM preference bias: GPT-4-Turbo and Command R+.
